description: Website intelligence tools: full site reports, page reading, page metadata, DNS lookups, domain profiles, sitemaps, feed reading, redirect traces, and link extraction. Each call is paid per use in USDC on Base through the x402 protocol, from the wallet of whoever runs the server.
name: io.github.asheeran/website-intelligence

environmentVariables.description: Private key of the wallet that pays for each call. Fund it with a small amount of USDC on Base and a little ETH for network costs if the wallet sends its own transactions.
environmentVariables.name: PAYER_PRIVATE_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Optional override for the API base address. Defaults to https://api.sitesy.ca.
environmentVariables.name: API_URL
